title: global_variable_update
description:
JSON payload of the `global_variable_update` topic, found in `data.json_string.data` of the `urinterfaces/msg/VariableUpdate` message.

The message contains the global variables of one logic program. A `diff` update with the changed variables is published while the logic program runs. A `full` update with all variables is published when the logic program stops. When the logic program starts, a `full` update with `sub_update_type` set to `initial` is published, which lists the names of all global variables with the value null.

update_type.description: `full` if the message contains all global variables, `diff` if it only contains the changed ones.

global_variables.description: Contains the id of the logic program and one object with the global variables, named after the logic program.

logic_program_id.description: Number of the logic program that the update belongs to.

sub_update_type.description: Only present in the first update of a started logic program, which contains the variable names only.

error.description: Present if the update did not fit in the message and is incomplete. When only part of the variables had to be left out, the same `error` entry is added inside the object of the logic program instead, next to the variables that did fit.

additionalProperties.description: The global variables of the logic program, as `name: value` pairs. The value is null in the initial update.
